referenceSources.description:
A white hatchback rally car emblazoned with the number 130 and vibrant rainbow stripes powers through a dusty gravel turn in a rural, wooded setting. Prominent sponsor logos—Crédit Mutuel on the door and Ferinel toward the rear—stand out against the car’s white paint, while additional decals like FIAT Garage Demol and driver blood types (A+ O. Berth, A+ A. Namke) appear near the front wheel arch.

The driver, secured by a visible roll cage, navigates the loose surface at speed, kicking up a cloud of dust behind the vehicle. This snapshot, shared on a French automotive forum, captures the raw energy and branding typical of regional rally competitions in the late 20th century.
